capabilities: Upload clipboard images to an image host on paste
Resize images before uploading with a configurable max width
Configure a custom upload API endpoint, headers, and body
Extract the hosted image URL from the HTTP response path
extras: Upload Body setting warns 'Don't change it unless you know what you are doing'; setup requires understanding HTTP request formats, with Imgur and Lsky-Pro given as worked examples.
problem: Obsidian stores pasted images as local vault files, which bloats the vault and doesn't work for publishing or syncing notes across devices.

requires.name: an image hosting service (e.g. Imgur or self-hosted Lsky-Pro)

summary: Paste-time uploader that resizes (optionally) and uploads clipboard images to a configurable image host, replacing them with a hosted URL.
